major_concerns: Deterministic validator completeness: false negatives could understate attack success.
Adversarial corpus coverage may miss realistic, creative attack variants.
Single frozen LLM (single-model) limits generality of conclusions across models/vendors.
Ethical risks from publishing exploit details; responsible‑disclosure plan must be explicit.
Definition of “unsafe/non‑compliant” requires rigorous, machine‑checkable specification to avoid ambiguity.
required_design_repairs: Validate and document validator coverage (unit tests, known‑case detection rates) and quantify expected false‑negative rates.
Expand or justify adversarial corpus construction (attack taxonomy, sampling strategy) and include held‑out novel attacks for evaluation robustness.
Either include at least one additional model or explicitly bound claims to the tested model and discuss generalization limits.
Add a clear responsible‑disclosure policy and redact actionable exploit details in public artifacts.
Provide precise operational definitions for unsafe/non‑compliant outputs and examples; include inter‑annotator checks if human labeling used.

major_concerns: Synthetic topologies may not capture production edge cases (external validity).
Deterministic validators may not model stateful or temporal behaviors, risking overconfident pass rates.
Compute and runtime for large (50‑device) topologies and Header‑Space‑style analyses may be high; bottlenecks need quantification.
Localized repair prompts can introduce vendor‑specific idioms causing new errors; cascading failure modes need monitoring.
required_design_repairs: Describe and validate topology synthesis method; include metrics comparing synthetic topologies to real traces or public topology corpora.
Specify validator coverage and limitations (stateless vs stateful behaviors), include test suite for validator correctness.
Define compute budget, per‑task timeout, and failure modes; provide backstop strategy if HSA analyses exceed runtime limits.
Provide explicit mitigation for repair‑induced vendor divergence (e.g., vendor‑aware prompt templates and post‑repair vendor‑consistency checks).
Include power/sample‑size justification or simulation showing expected detectable effect sizes given planned N per scale.

major_concerns: Benchmark design choices can bias toward certain methods (benchmark overfitting).
Synthetic realism vs real operator data: risk of missing production artifacts.
Public release requires rigorous redaction/licensing to avoid exposing sensitive operational data.
Validators may oversimplify stateful or temporal properties, limiting coverage.
required_design_repairs: Provide a clear, reproducible topology and intent generation protocol and report coverage metrics (diversity, complexity).
Include validator test‑suite with coverage reports and known‑case detection rates; document limitations (statefulness, timing).
State licensing, redaction, and responsible‑release policy; include artifact hashes and reproducibility scripts.
Provide baseline results and exact runbooks for reproducibility (containerized environments, seeds, host‑API versions).
Add guidance for community adoption and maintenance (versioning, issue tracker, governance).

major_concerns: Planned human‑operator recruitment conflicts with capability_manifest constraints disallowing human scientific labour; feasibility depends on validated expert‑proxy approach.
IRB/ethics and consent procedures are underspecified and may block execution.
Construct validity: expert‑proxy scoring may not faithfully reproduce operator decisions.
Sandbox simulator fidelity may miss rollback triggers, affecting external validity.
Calibration and interpretability of presented confidence metrics must be validated to avoid overreliance.
required_design_repairs: If live operators are not permitted, specify and validate an expert‑proxy procedure (how proxies are selected, validated against real operators, and limitations).
Include a concrete IRB/ethics plan or, if human subjects are excluded, adapt protocol to a fully simulated/evaluation proxy workflow and justify construct validity.
Describe sandbox fidelity and include stress tests showing simulator captures rollback‑relevant failures.
Provide calibration procedure for confidence metrics (e.g., reliability diagrams, Brier score) and evaluate their trustworthiness before use.
Predefine reviewer sampling, washout/randomization, and pre‑registered analysis to improve reproducibility and reduce bias.
